title: "I just wanna…": your dream-life list, then the real reveal
summary: "I just wanna…" over dreamy clips of the life you'd love, then a funny or honest reveal. AI writes the lines and the shot list.
why: Later's Instagram Reels list, updated November 6, 2026, adds "I just wanna": dreamy lifestyle clips with "I just wanna…" on screen, set to a new pop song, then a reveal of what the creator would actually spend the money on. InMagic's list for the week of November 9, 2026 has the same "dream-life reveal", ending on the real work or result.
steps: Use the main prompt to get several "I just wanna…" lines and a reveal that fits you.
Film three or four short, pretty clips you already have the chance to shoot: a coffee by the window, a snowy walk, a cosy blanket.
Put one line on each clip, then cut to the reveal shot on the beat. Keep it under 12 seconds.
Add the trending sound in the app you post to. Business accounts should pick a sound cleared for commercial use.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Help me make a short Instagram Reel in the "I just wanna…" format. The first part shows dreamy clips of a slow, comfortable life with "I just wanna…" lines on screen. The last clip is a funny, honest reveal. About me: [your job, hobbies, where you live in Canada, what a dream day looks like to you]. Write 5 versions. Each has 3 short "I just wanna…" lines (under 8 words each) and one reveal line (under 10 words). Make the reveals light and relatable, like what I'd really spend the money on. Then suggest one simple clip I could film for each line, using things I already have at home.

prompts.label: Variation: the real-work reveal
prompts.text: Rewrite the "I just wanna…" Reel so the reveal is the work behind the dream instead of a joke. The dreamy lines show what I'm working toward: [describe your goal, for example a cabin trip, a home studio, paying off a course]. The reveal shows me doing the unglamorous part: [describe it, for example a late shift, studying at the kitchen table, packing orders]. Give me 5 versions with 3 lines and one reveal line each. Keep it upbeat and honest, with no promises about money or results.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Write an "I just wanna…" Reel for my small business, a [type of business] in [town or city, Canada]. The dreamy lines are things our customers want to feel, for example warm, slow mornings or a fresh new look. The reveal shows how we help, in one plain line, with no prices, discounts or made-up claims. Give me 5 versions with 3 lines and one reveal each, plus a shot idea for each line I can film in our space.

tips: Keep the dream lines soft and short. The reveal is the joke, so give it the most time on screen.
Real clips beat polished ones here. A steamy mug and a window are enough.
Keep money talk light. Skip real prices, debts or "get rich" claims.
Post the reveal shot as the cover so people know there's a twist.
